data.narrative:
Scout AI, a Seed-stage Defense & Security company founded by Colby Adcock and Collin Otis, has raised $15M to date. The relevant peer universe comprises 10 comparables: 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, and Shield AI, spanning Seed and Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods apply. Stage-Progression analysis uses the $15M raised as a valuation proxy and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical for Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying $38M. Peer-Median analysis of three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, and NODA AI at $125M) yields a median of $400M, with a range spanning $125M to $1.0B.

These methods produce a triangulated range of $32M to $460M, with a median of $219M. The wide spread reflects material uncertainty around which peer cohort most closely approximates Scout AI's trajectory and competitive positioning. Stage-Progression suggests a floor near $32M based on dilution mechanics. The $400M peer median and upper-range valuations depend critically on whether Scout AI's commercial traction, technical differentiation, and addressable market warrant comparison to later-stage or higher-valued cohort members. Near-term validation through customer wins and contract value will be essential to narrow this range.
